While the shot was more than 70% effective at preventing the tick-borne disease in the trial, not enough people contracted the disease for the findings to be conclusive.  Pfizer is pushing ahead with its plans to seek regulatory approval anyway, saying the study hit a different statistical measure and the shot showed “meaningful efficacy.”
